description.value:
Merfolk are not all the same species, rather 'merfolk' is a general term for aquatic humanoids of varying appearances who live primarily in the water. Some look like generally humanoid fish or like mermaids, and some look closer to humans. What they all share is an adaptation to life underwater, even in conditions most humanoids would find extreme.

Size: Medium

Walking Speed: 30 ft.

Senses: &Reference[Darkvision] 120 ft.

Damage Resistance: &reference[Cold]

&reference[Swim] Speed: Equal to walking speed +10 ft.

@UUID[Compendium.elkan5e.elkan5e-ancestry-background.Item.zS5YU0ewCqTMDmDQ]{Amphibious}

In the world of Elkan, merfolk inhabit a number of places. In Takat, the merfolk come up onto the land periodically on pilgrimages that take them from the abyssal depths of the ocean to the inhabited islands. These merfolk are biologically varied and poorly understood. The human-like merfolk near Lennington belong to the Kingdom of Jass, which is a totalitarian society that has created massive underwater cities on top of thermal vents. Jass exiles make up the majority of merfolk in Lennington and nearby Morventry.
